evidence: Original allocation, conditional construction and publication control with supplied allocator and constructor services
limitations: Allocator and constructor services are supplied; their internal effects are not executed in this comparison.
Null allocator returns are injected; the native allocator may instead throw or terminate.
No native allocator-null failure guarantee follows.
The source global is an opaque allocator input, not a recovered pool identity.
Synthetic state tests do not prove full startup ordering or concurrency safety.
